full_track.tags: K-Indie pop with a bossa nova influence. Clean electric guitar plays syncopated jazz chords with a light chorus effect. A fretless bass guitar provides melodic counterpoint with slides and vibrato. Percussion consists of a shaker, a woodblock on the upbeat, and a soft kick drum. Female vocals are delivered in a breathy, intimate style with close-mic proximity. The arrangement features a Rhodes piano playing sustained chords and occasional melodic fills. Key of E Major, 92 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
